# SerpCraft

> Free SEO meta tag studio: generate meta tags, Open Graph, Twitter Cards, JSON-LD structured data, robots.txt, and pixel-accurate SERP previews. Includes a Release Diff tool that compares staging vs production URLs to catch SEO regressions before deploy (HTTP status, redirects, canonicals, meta tags, Open Graph, JSON-LD, hreflang), and a URL debugger that shows exactly what search engines and social platforms read from any page.

## Tools

- Release Diff (staging vs production SEO regression check): https://metaforge.app/release-diff
- SEO Check (free 21-point website audit + AI-readiness score): https://metaforge.app/seo-check
- SEO Studio (all-in-one editor + previews): https://metaforge.app/studio
- URL Debugger (see what crawlers actually read): https://metaforge.app/url-debugger
- llms.txt Generator (AI crawler file builder): https://metaforge.app/llms-txt-generator
- Hreflang Generator (multilingual tags with validation): https://metaforge.app/hreflang-generator
- OG Image Checker (server-side image verification): https://metaforge.app/og-image-checker
- Social Meta Generator (Open Graph, Twitter/X Cards, meta tags): https://metaforge.app/social-meta
- JSON-LD Toolkit (generator + validator for structured data): https://metaforge.app/json-ld
- Schema Markup Generator: https://metaforge.app/schema-markup-generator
- Social Preview Tool: https://metaforge.app/social-preview-tool
- SERP Preview Tool: https://metaforge.app/serp-preview-tool
- Robots.txt Generator: https://metaforge.app/robots-txt-generator

## Pricing

- Free: all tools, no signup. https://metaforge.app/pricing.md
- Pro (planned): higher rate limits, batch diff, history. https://metaforge.app/pricing.md

## About

SerpCraft is a free, browser-based SEO meta tag studio. All user data stays in the browser via localStorage. No signup required. The Release Diff tool is the first AI-search-readiness guard for pre-launch deployment workflows.
